what: a copper axe: a broad wedge-shaped head of cast bright orange copper with a peach highlight, on a long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel, a gold collar where head meets handle. The handle runs along the canvas diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right; the axe head sits at the handle's top end and follows that diagonal: its cutting edge is a straight or gently curved line running perpendicular to the handle, from the upper left down to the lower right (along the canvas's other diagonal), never a vertical edge and never parallel to the canvas sides.
